k-hippo.title: Fiona the Hippo coins
k-hippo.sourceSays: Posts say Fiona, the Cincinnati Zoo hippo, has died; a sports account says a Bengals player wore a sweatshirt honoring her, and a memecoin recap links the news to $FIONA coins.
k-hippo.reason: Posts of Nov 19-23 from a sports news account, a Cincinnati Enquirer editor and a memecoin recap describe the hippo's death and tributes; the coins are tributes launched after the news, not official.
